data.one_liner: Convert between quill delta format and markdown.
data.what_it_does: Provides converters to translate text between markdown documents and flutter_quill Delta format. Supports customization like custom syntax, block attributes, and embed handlers.
use_when: You need to persist flutter_quill content as markdown in your app.
You want to render markdown content inside a flutter_quill editor.
avoid_when: You require full image alt text retention, as only image sources are currently retained.
strengths: Supports bi-directional conversion between markdown and quill Delta.
Allows custom elements, attributes, and embed handlers.
weaknesses: Image alts are currently not supported (only image src is retained).
Block attributes exclusivity rules from flutter_quill apply.
